At 9094943b88c8, with `per_page=100`: lint, typecheck, test, pr-title and build all `success`. I waited for `test` rather than passing the round around it, and ran nothing locally this round: the fingerprint is unchanged and the merge's only own edit is a changelog, so a local suite run would have been reassurance rather than evidence. Three traps for whoever reads CI here next: these commits carry 30 or more check runs, so a `gh api …/check-runs` without `per_page=100` silently drops some of the required set; a push carrying code and handoff together leaves the code commit with no run of its own; and a run can show `cancelled` lanes beside a `success` one in the same run id, which is GitHub's concurrency cancelling a superseded run rather than a failure (5c6d3ada654e is this branch's worked example).
